noms.text: Solomon no Kagi 2 : Coolmintou Kyuushutsu Sakusen

synopsis.text: The peaceful island Coolmint is attacked by flame monsters sent by the evil wizard Druidle. The queen of the winter fairies chooses the novice wizard Dana to drive back the monsters. Fire 'n Ice is a puzzle game where the goal is to extinguish all flames by pushing or dropping blocks onto them. You can create or destroy ice blocks, climb blocks and push loose blocks. Ice is created diagonally in the direction faced, if there is already an ice block there, it will be destroyed. However, ice blocks cannot be created on a spot that is already occupied by a flame, so you have to find a way to create ice blocks next to or above a flame so that they can be pushed or dropped onto it. If an ice block is created next to another object or wall it will stick to it, meaning it can't be moved and won't fall down. So it's possible to create ice bridges to get over chasms. When a loose ice block is pushed, it slides above the ground until it hits another object. Rocks can also be used but they are indestructible and only move one space when pushed (unless on icy surface).

Vous aimez les puzzles et la logique, alors vous aimerez Solomon's Key 2.
Des monstres de feu ont été libérés sur Coolmint Island, vous devez utiliser vos compétences et votre cerveau pour terminer chaque niveau et vaincre le sorcier maléfique.
Attention! Vous pourriez vous perdre dans ce jeu passionnant et ne plus pouvoir vous arrêter!

Die friedliche Insel Coolmint wird von Flammenmonstern angegriffen, die der böse Zauberer Druidle gesandt hat. Die Königin der Winterfeen wählt den Anfänger-Zauberer Dana, um die Monster zurückzutreiben. Solomons Key2 ist ein Puzzlespiel aus der klassischen Seitenansicht, Ziel ist es durch ein Labyrinth von Eisblöcken die Level durchzuschreiten. Das erstellen eigener Level ist mit dem integrierten Level-Editor ebenfalls möglich.

Solomon's Key 2 (o Fire 'n Ice en EE. UU.) Es un juego de rompecabezas en el que debes extinguir todas las llamas de un nivel presionando bloques de hielo. Tu personaje puede crear estos bloques de hielo y empujarlos para colocarlos donde se necesitan. Un editor de niveles le permite construir sus propios niveles en caso de que los originales no sean suficientes.

Se ti piacciono i puzzle e la logica, allora ti piacerà Solomon's Key 2.
I mostri di fuoco sono stati rilasciati su Coolmint Island, devi usare la tua abilità e il tuo cervello per completare ogni livello e sconfiggere il mago malvagio.
Attenzione! Potresti perderti in questo gioco emozionante e non puoi fermarti!

A pacífica ilha Coolmint é atacada por monstros de chamas enviados pelo malvado bruxo Druidle. A rainha das fadas do inverno escolhe a bruxa novata Dana para afastar os monstros. Fire 'n Ice é um jogo de quebra-cabeças visto de uma perspectiva lateral. O objetivo
